No later movement had been applied and there was no receipt, so a resend was consistent with what was known then. The WARD-C move came from the ward side, not from the PAS feed. The evidence does not say who entered it, or why that move had no bed. A site that keeps a full movement history would send this case to a person, so the WARD-B stay could be recorded in its place (W1). That is not this site's setting. If WARD-C or the missing bed looks wrong, the ward should confirm it.
